context_for_next_testing_agent: All multisite navigation fixes are working correctly. The navTo() helper functions in CalendarPage.js, ContentCalendarPage.js, AdminApprovalPage.js, TrashPage.js, and RDSBuilderPage.js properly prefix URLs with the main site slug (e.g., /radiogroep/shows/{id}). Backend endpoints get_show, get_rundown, create_rundown_item properly use X-Main-Site-ID header for data isolation.
rca_of_the_issue: The original bug was that navigation links were using incorrect paths (e.g., /shows/{id} instead of /radiogroep/shows/{id}). The fixes involved adding navTo() helper functions to frontend pages that correctly prefix paths with mainSite.slug. Backend endpoints were updated to check X-Main-Site-ID header for multisite-aware data isolation.
